## Recommendation: Flip Coefficient Sign

It appears that Company ABC inadvertantly negated the coefficient for `log(principal_balance)` in the model documentation.

The validation team recommends that Company ABC correct the model documentation and work with the model implementation team to make sure that the production model is correctly parameterized.

:::
